task: Implement process_event for the event bus without using webhook delivery behavior.

candidate_memories.content: Event bus process_event dequeues a message, applies routing rules, and dispatches to subscribers.
Event bus delivery is at-least-once; consumers must be idempotent against duplicate messages.
Dead-letter handling kicks in after the configured retry limit, not on any first failure.
When process_event spans bus and webhook systems, confirm the delivery model before implementing.
Webhook handler: process_event validates the signature, parses the payload, and calls the handler function.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: webhook request-response semantics conflict with async event bus dispatch logic

candidate_memories.content: Old integration note says event processing should be unified under a single process_event interface.
